title: Schema Drift Detection
dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results (`soda:scan`), dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.
app: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom warehouse data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=dbx:warehouse_columns
| stats latest(column_signature) as current_sig by table_name
| eval prev_sig=coalesce(current_sig,"")
| lookup schema_baseline table_name OUTPUT column_signature as baseline_sig
| where isnotnull(baseline_sig) AND current_sig!=baseline_sig
| sort table_name
description: Compares each table's current column set against a stored baseline and flags added, dropped, or retyped columns before they break downstream models and reports.
value: Unannounced schema changes are a leading cause of broken pipelines; detecting drift gives data teams a chance to adapt before dashboards fail.
implementation: Probe column metadata via DB Connect; maintain a `schema_baseline` lookup; schedule daily; alert on drift and refresh the baseline after review.
visualization: Table of drifted tables, timeline of schema changes.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the shape of your data tables and flag when columns are added, removed, or changed, before it breaks a report.
